mismatch_detection_goal: Find reasons a referral may not work for the target center before scoring fit.

mismatch_types.authorization_missing: Payer authorization is pending, missing, or not attached.
mismatch_types.mar_missing: Current medication list/MAR is missing or referenced but not attached.
mismatch_types.memory_care_gap: Referral suggests secured memory care or wandering risk, but target facility lacks locked memory-care capability.
mismatch_types.behavioral_high_acuity: Behavioral/safety risk may exceed facility behavioral acuity capability.
mismatch_types.dialysis_transport_coordination: Dialysis transport or chair-time logistics require manual coordination before admission.
mismatch_types.wound_orders_missing: Wound care orders or dressing frequency are unclear.
mismatch_types.iv_antibiotics_nurse_review: IV antibiotic need triggers nursing/clinical review.
mismatch_types.tracheostomy_gap: Complex tracheostomy care appears required and target facility does not support complex trach.
mismatch_types.payer_not_accepted: Payer is not accepted by the target facility.
mismatch_types.contradiction_isolation: Source documents conflict on whether isolation precautions are active.
mismatch_types.allergies_missing: Allergy status is absent or not clearly listed.
mismatch_types.diet_swallow_orders_missing: Diet texture/liquid consistency/swallow precautions are missing or unclear.
mismatch_types.no_skilled_need_documented: Referral may lack a documented daily skilled nursing or therapy need.
mismatch_types.financial_paperwork_missing: Responsible party, deposit, or financial paperwork is missing.
mismatch_types.bariatric_equipment_gap: Bariatric bed/equipment appears required but target facility lacks bariatric equipment.
mismatch_types.allergies_low_confidence: Allergy information appears only in low-confidence OCR/handwriting.
mismatch_types.mobility_conflict: Transfer or assist level conflicts across notes.
mismatch_types.picc_documentation_missing: PICC placement or line documentation is not attached.
mismatch_types.isolation_bed_required: Isolation/private room need requires bed/capacity review.
mismatch_types.qualifying_stay_unclear: Medicare qualifying inpatient stay or waiver is unclear.
mismatch_types.not_snf_level_of_care: Referral appears to be assisted-living/respite rather than skilled nursing level of care.
mismatch_types.payer_contract_unclear: Payer contract/VA authorization status is unclear.
mismatch_types.therapy_participation_unclear: Therapy participation or rehab potential is unclear.
mismatch_types.ventilator_gap: Ventilator support appears required and target facility does not support ventilators.
mismatch_types.after_hours_admission_not_supported: Requested transfer time appears outside facility admission hours.
mismatch_types.nutrition_orders_missing: Diet order or nutrition supplement plan is missing/unclear.
mismatch_types.specialized_care_orders_missing: Specialized bowel/bladder or care program orders are missing.
mismatch_types.mechanical_lift_nurse_review: Mechanical lift/total assist need requires nursing/operations review.
mismatch_types.contradiction_behavioral_status: Source documents conflict on behavioral/elopement risk.
mismatch_types.behavioral_log_missing: Behavioral incident log is missing for a memory-care referral.
mismatch_types.assisted_living_level_mismatch: Referral need appears higher than assisted living can safely support.
mismatch_types.two_person_assist_not_supported: Two-person assist is required but target assisted living facility does not support it.

severity_guidance.high: Likely blocks admission or requires immediate escalation.
severity_guidance.medium: Could delay admission or requires clarification.
